title: Free Pool Service Software 2026: Free Plans vs Free Trials
description: Is there free pool service software? None of the pool tools we track has a free plan. Here are their free trials, cheapest paid plans and real costs.
h1: Best free pool service software: what's actually free
body:
If you searched for free pool service software, here's the honest answer from vendors' own pages (checked October 2026): none of the pool service tools we track publishes a free-forever plan. What they do offer is free trials, a free first month, or a refund guarantee. Below is exactly what each one gives you for free and what it costs afterwards. For the full comparison, see best pool service software.

What's free with each pool tool

The cheapest way to start a pool route

  • Under 49 pools: Skimmer Getting Started is $49/mo flat until you pass 49 serviced locations, with unlimited techs. GorillaDesk Basic is also $49/mo for one route with unlimited users, but routing is capped at 25 stops.
  • One tech, many pools: Pool Brain works out to $115/mo for one field tech ($50 base + $65), regardless of pool count, by its published formula.
  • Seasonal crews: Pool Office Manager lets you deactivate users in the off-season; Skimmer doesn't bill locations you didn't service that month.
  • Mixed pool and other trades, one person: QuoteIQ Essentials is $29.99/mo; chemical tracking starts on Pro ($199.99/mo).

What about general free tools?

Free field service plans do exist outside pool-specific software, for example Yardbook Starter and LawnPro Solo, but both are built for lawn care and list no pool chemistry features. See lawn care software cost if you also cut grass. For pool work you'll likely want water chemistry logging, which Skimmer (LSI and dosing calculator on Scaling Up), Pool Brain and Pool Office Manager list on their pages.

Getting the most from a free trial

  • Load one real week of your route and run it end to end, including invoicing.
  • Check whether your card is charged automatically at the end (Pool Office Manager says it charges on day 30 unless you cancel; QuoteIQ requires a card to start).
  • Compare scheduling side by side in pool service scheduling software, and use the software buying checklist.

faq: Is there free pool service software?
Among the pool tools we track (Skimmer, Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, GorillaDesk), none publishes a free-forever plan as of October 2026. They offer free trials or a free first month instead.
Which pool software has the longest free trial?

Pool Office Manager lists a 30-day trial with every feature. Skimmer offers a free first month of Scaling Up as a promotion plus a 30-day refund guarantee. Pool Brain and GorillaDesk don't state trial lengths.
What is the cheapest pool service software?
Skimmer Getting Started and GorillaDesk Basic both start at $49/mo. Skimmer charges $1 per serviced location with a $49 minimum; GorillaDesk charges per route with unlimited users.
Do I need a credit card for a pool software trial?
Pool Office Manager says you enter a card at signup and nothing is charged until day 30. QuoteIQ requires a card for its 14-day trial. Others don't say on their pricing pages.
